assumptions: Floor-to-floor heights: 1F ceiling_height=3.0m, 2F z_floor=3.0m/ceiling_height=3.6m, taken from the North/South elevation overall 6600mm dimension chain (3000mm lower band + 3600mm upper band), confirmed by calibrated elevation overlays (roof/ground/floor-line pixel positions matched the chain to within rounding).
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
Interior door heights (all F1 D-N/D-S and F2 D-N/D-S doors) are assumed 2.1m: no plan or elevation drawing dimensions an interior door height.
unresolved: Pixel-to-world calibration for each plan/elevation image was supplied by the agent from the drawings' own dimension chains and outer wall faces; it was cross-checked between plan and elevation (independent chains agree to within ~1%) but not independently verified by a third source.

F1:EXT-S-WIN1 (room_wc) and F1 corridor E/W windows use dimension chains adjacent to, but not unambiguously labelled as, those specific openings; assignment is by position and is the most consistent reading found, but remains a judgment call rather than a directly labelled chain.
